QF.id: VI Introduction to the Indian Capital Market_21

question.text: Which entity's secretariat served the High Level Coordination Committee on Financial Markets (HLCCFM) before it was replaced by FSDC?

answer.text: Ministry of Finance (Capital Market Division, Department of Economic Affairs)
Securities and Exchange Board of India

explanation.text: The Logic: The secretariat of HLCCFM was located in the Ministry of Finance, specifically in the Capital Market Division of the Department of Economic Affairs. HLCCFM was replaced by the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC) in 2010. The Trap: 'SEBI' is a prominent securities regulator but did not house the HLCCFM secretariat. The coordination committee was housed under the Ministry of Finance. Note: The Series VI workbook (p.14) is the controlling source for HLCCFM being replaced by FSDC in 2010 and for the secretariat being located in the Ministry of Finance (Capital Market Division, Department of Economic Affairs).
